messages:
Mae: heads up — I’m seeing a 3x jump in sampled request/response logs for tenant 'acme-prod' after enabling ephemeral inspect TTL yesterday. we need to decide sampling + quota behaviour + console visibility ASAP.
Simon: any example traces we can look at?
Mae: pasted a tiny config and one redacted snippet below:
```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","sampling":0.05,"inspect_ttl_seconds":900,"redact":true,"destination":"ephemeral-audit"}
```
Ana: is that sampling rate per-route or a global override?
Mae: per-route override; fallbacks to global sampler if missing.
Chris: we should make this tier-aware. Dedicated SLA customers should default to 0.5% sampling, free tier 5%. otherwise storage and cost explode. :thinking:
Luis: console needs an "Inspect Budget" widget — show per-tenant sampled fraction, projected samples/day, and remaining budget vs quota.
Mae: also found a redaction hole — emails embedded in base64 blobs are leaking. scrubber only looks for plain emails.
Ana: great catch. we should run pseudonymization + regex + entropy checks on blobs. also add a flag to opt-in to full-content audit for security teams.
ops-oncall: from ops POV we need safe defaults: cap sampled events/sec per-tenant + a circuit breaker that drops to headers-only if storage or write latency spikes.
Simon: proposal for config schema:
```yaml
sampler:
  default_rate: 0.02
  per_route:
    - route: "/v1/generate"
      rate: 0.01
      ttl: 600
      redact_profile: "default-v2"
  quotas:
    quota_per_minute: 1200  # samples/min per tenant
    burst: 200
```
Note: quotas are enforced in the runtime and surfaced to console.
Chris: audit-only mode idea: write fully-redacted payloads to secure bucket with KMS, retention 30d, only accessible by compliance. default off for non-enterprise.
Luis: UX: show recent sampled events blurred by default with a redact-score pill (good/partial/fail) and ability to request a temporary unredact with 2FA + audit log.
Mae: quick cost calc: 100k QPS * 0.01 sampling = 1k samples/s -> ~86M samples/day. at ~1KB per sample that’s ~86GB/day. we need quota gating or enterprise-negotiated retention.
Ana: action items: 1) regex+blob heuristics PR (Ana) 2) quota/circuit-breaker runtime ticket (Simon) 3) Inspect Budget UX mock (Luis) 4) audit-only retention + KMS flow spec (Chris) 5) update default sampler profiles and doc (Mae).
Simon: I’ll open the runtime ticket and add a quick PoC that enforces quota_per_minute and a soft-fail path (headers-only) when exceeded.
ops-oncall: recommend canary rollout for sampler-config v3 to 5% of traffic and keep detailed metrics for 48h.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started: sampler-config v3 -> 5% of traffic across us-west-2 for tenant subsets [acme-prod, beta-corp]).
Mae: thanks — please post check-ins here. if we see redact-failures escalate, flip inspect_ttl down and enable circuit breaker. :thumbsup:
